description_en: Creates a configuration backup export task. Only one configuration backup export task can run at a time for a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 创建配置备份导出任务。一个堡垒机实例只能同时存在一个正在运行的配置备份导出任务
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-export-config-job --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExportConfigJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the Bastionhost instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance for which you want to export the configuration backup.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要导出配置备份的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

JobId.description_en:
The ID of the configuration backup export task.

You can call the GetExportConfigJob operation to obtain the details of this task. Make sure to record the task ID
JobId.description_zh:
配置备份导出任务ID。
调用GetExportConfigJob接口可获取本次任务详情，请记好任务ID

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
